Does a camera dictionary work without an internet connection?

A camera dictionary works offline when both text recognition and the dictionary resources are available on the phone. Check what the app installs and test it in airplane mode; download size alone does not tell you whether a lookup needs the internet.

Booktionary includes English definitions. You can choose from 24 book languages in total and download the other dictionaries before reading. Optional word-translation packs add equivalents for English books. Once installed, these resources and camera recognition work offline.

Internet access is needed to load the language catalog and download resources. Complete downloads before travelling. The separate Google search button opens an external search and needs a connection; it is not part of the offline dictionary lookup.

Offline availability does not guarantee that every word has an entry. Dictionary coverage and camera recognition still matter. Try a few words from your own book before relying on the app without a connection.

Check before reading offline

  1. While connected, select the book language and finish its download.
  2. For an English book, install any optional translation resources you want to use.
  3. Turn on airplane mode and make sure Wi-Fi is off.
  4. Open the app and look up several words from your book. If a resource is missing, reconnect and finish downloading it before leaving.

See the app, all supported languages and download requirements.
